profile.headline: Software Engineer • I take care of complex state modeling so you don’t have to
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer (IC3) – Code Understanding Team
profile.summary:
Engineer who takes projects over the finish line. Lead Developer for Coder's official SDK in Spotify Backstage. Main developer for rebooting the Coder Registry into an open-source ecosystem (3x contributions and +15M downloads in 2025). I specialize in complex state management for React/TypeScript UIs, and concurrent systems in Go. I also know my way around the MERN stack.

I love taking highly technical domains and making them approachable to any kind of user – the internet should be for everyone.

GitHub: https://github.com/buenos-nachos

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (IC3) – Code Understanding Team
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer – Core Team, North America Region
positions.description:
• Served as Lead Developer for Coder’s React-based client SDK in Spotify’s Backstage platform, unlocking sales for over ten Fortune 500 companies, and driving a ~20% increase in marketing seminar attendance in H1 2024.
• Led the reboot of the Coder Registry, converting an internal tool into an ecosystem for publishing open-source plugins. Tripled outside contributions and increased plugin downloads by 24 million from Jan 2025–May 2026.
• Co-led rewrite for the Coder Registry Terraform Server, delivering full rewrite for critical infrastructure from Next.js to Go in two months. Improved server availability from ~93% in late 2024 to +99.99% in all of 2025.

• Reviewed résumés, graded take-homes, and interviewed 60+ mid-level and senior engineers over 20 months; was unanimously nominated to design rubrics and code challenges for first-ever staff-level frontend engineers.
• Acted as Code Owner for flagship product’s frontend, guiding open-source contributors and four global teams on UI engineering best practices. Reduced turnaround time for frontend PRs by ~2 days in Q3 2025.
• Rewrote data-fetching layer into dependency-injectable UI client, cutting test flakes in half though improved state isolation, and streamlining the API vendoring process for Backstage and Coder’s VSCode plugin.
• Owned implementations and test suites for state management in the flagship frontend, designing well-tested, type-safe tools for WebSocket message parsing, pagination prefetching, and Go-to-TypeScript SSR hydration.
• Provided consulting to design team and brand agencies for UI mockups for dashboards and marketing sites; stopped 40+ mobile UI edge cases and WCAG Level AA violations from reaching the implementation stage.
• Mentored and oversaw Coder’s first intern, ensuring all feature work was completed on time in Q3 2025.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Migrated files in ed tech platform to TypeScript and Redux, delivering updates two months ahead of schedule.
• Designed new state management strategies in the React codebase, allowing components to opt intomutation-based UI updates decoupled from React’s render cycles, boosting average performance by over 40%.
• Wrote Zod schemas to replace type guards for form validation and 3rd-party API calls, letting types be defined runtime-first, simplifying maintenance for type definitions, and reducing error rates by over 10%.
• Maintained documentation to improve accuracy and clarity, and wrote technical articles for student-customers, covering topics like environment setup and the key concepts around request caching.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Central Office
positions.description:
• Built BigQuery pipelines for product catalogs. Automated four-hour cleaning processes for datasets with 100k+ items into reproducible, two-second tasks, while reducing missing data fields by 45% for accurate reporting.
• Rewrote legacy scripts into Google Apps Script, increasing the performance for fuzzy matching, data querying, and automated reporting by +400%, and improving integrations with in-house JavaScript tooling.
• Worked on a broker management tool in Angular, creating various components for the in-house design system, and wrote algorithms for modeling rapidly-changing broker relationships.
• Codified formal guidelines for doing code reviews, raising average ZenDesk SLA ticket compliance by 28%.

positions.title: Buyer – Wellness Department, Store-Level
positions.description:
• Created Python scripts for generating low-stock inventory reports, slashing overstock and out-of-stock counts for the department by an average of 5% per period.
• Created a UI for cross-referencing shelf tags against inventory backstock to identify which items could be stocked out, speeding up the process for replacing inventory by an average of 2 employee hours per day.
• Performed inventory audits to reconcile backstock against database inventory counts, addressing variances in inventory value by a minimum of $10,000 per audit.

Accomplishments
• Most profitable wellness department in the company in 2019.
• Most profitable store in the company in 2019.
positions.insights: JavaScript, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +1 skill
